name: Ombi-Discord-Router
description: Companion service for MediaOps that receives Ombi webhook notifications and routes media request lifecycle updates into managed Discord Forum threads.

paths.name: Router Data
paths.description: Persistent Ombi Discord Router request/thread index.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used by the router for log timestamps.

variables.name: Media Requests Webhook
variables.description: Full Discord Forum webhook URL. Secret: the URL contains a Discord credential and must not be published.

variables.name: Webhook Display Name
variables.description: Display name used by the Discord webhook when posting request lifecycle updates.

variables.name: Requested Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID applied to newly submitted media requests that are waiting to be processed.

variables.name: Processing Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID used when a media request has been approved or is currently being processed.

variables.name: Available Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID used when the requested media is available on the configured media server. This is a terminal request state.

variables.name: Failed Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID used when processing or acquiring the requested media has failed. This is a terminal request state.

variables.name: Denied Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID used when a media request has been denied or rejected. This is a terminal request state.

variables.name: Movie Media Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying a request as a movie. This media-type tag is preserved throughout the request lifecycle.

variables.name: Series Media Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying a request as a TV series. This media-type tag is preserved throughout the request lifecycle.

variables.name: Test Tag ID
variables.description: Optional Discord Forum tag ID used only by Ombi's built-in Webhook Send test action. Test posts carry only this tag, are not indexed as media requests, and are ignored by the MediaOps request lifecycle.

variables.name: Router Data Directory
variables.description: Container path for the persistent request/thread index. Leave at /data for the packaged deployment.
